input.summary:
Carriage bay furnished in parts/room-31.mjs: an open landau on a plank chassis (dark_oak stairs as seats, fence hood posts with standing lanterns) square to the north doors, hay and barrels on the west wall, tack chest, candle and cauldron on the east, lanterns on the barrels and floor.
`$MCD room` says OK: 168/168 floor cells walkable, min light 8, 0 dim or dark cells, FIT OK. make.sh wrote a whole build.nbt; my part placed 72 blocks with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE lines.
The room rendered from above and inside reads as a carriage in a bay; the room's walls and loft floor are not in this copy, so only the isolated room was checked.
left: Wheels are fence posts on the chassis corners, not real wheels, and the landau has no canopy: a simplified look for a focal piece.

Hanging lanterns under the loft floor (y6) were dropped: the loft floor is the outbuildings part's and isn't in this copy. All lights now stand on posts, barrels or the floor, so the room doesn't depend on it.
`mcd check` reports the ladder at x90 z52 (y1..7) unsupported: its backing wall (the east and south shell walls) is the outbuildings part's and is missing here. Recheck on the merged build.
plan.md's Checklist has no room-part tick and elements.md has no carriage-bay-specific item, so nothing was ticked; the carriage house item stays with the outbuildings part.
Full-building render (make.sh tiles) was not run; only the isolated room check and rooms view were.

waste.what: Drew the 14x12 floor for each of the 4 furniture layers by hand, counting character indices to place wheels, seats, posts and lanterns (several index-count mistakes, fixed by re-reading the room check).
waste.cost: about 6 layer rows rewritten, 3 retries of the room check and make.sh
waste.tool: a layers-from-plan helper that takes named objects with cell coordinates (e.g. place('barrel', x, y, z)) and checks the footprint against the plan grid, so no character counting is needed.

waste.what: Chose lantern positions by trial: placed hanging lanterns, saw FIT float them (loft floor missing in this copy), moved them to standing posts, then added two floor lanterns after the room check named the dim cells.
waste.tool: `$MCD room` lantern suggestions could be written straight into the layer rows, and a flag that tells a hanging lantern to stand on a post when the ceiling block is not yet built.

waste.what: Checked the light map and walkable cells by eye against the 14x12 grid to confirm the lanes to doors and the ladder foot stayed clear.
waste.cost: one room check read by eye
waste.tool: `$MCD room` already prints the lane; a check of 'door first-cell clear' and 'ladder foot clear' lines would replace the eyeballing.

companions.task: Build the landau properly: real wheels with spokes, a folding canopy and the shafts pointing out to the doors, instead of fence-post wheels.
Stock the tack wall with harness on trapdoor shelves and a hay loft ladder; put the saddle rack and water bucket by the east door.
